text: Hello, boys and girls, nice to see you again.First, let's take a look at what we are going to do in today's class.Look at the picture.It's a nice jellyfish, isn't it?If you see such a nice jellyfish on the beach, will you touch it?Probably not.You are not sure whether it is poisonous or not.I won't touch it either.How can I know more about it?I will try to get more information on the Internet.Perhaps I will read some books about sea animals.Very often, the articles on jellyfish are expository texts.We can get more knowledge based on facts by reading expository texts.Do you remember this article?It's from 8A Oxford English.It introduces the joint pander to us.Let's take a look at the structure.It's the introduction.They are the body paragraphs.And there is an ending in this article.在之前的课中,我们提到过说明文的结语,还记得吗?不同写作意图的说明文,结语不尽相同,有的说明文没有结语。这篇文章的结语是为了保护我们的联合联盟。现在,让我们来看看我们学到的一些宣传文章。让我们以联合联盟作为一个例子。当你读到这篇文章的名字时,你会想知道什么?例如,哪里在中国的联合联盟居住?什么样的联合联盟看起来像?什么样的联合联盟吃?联合联盟的体系特征有很多描述。这篇文章里,有很多关于大熊猫体型特征的描述,作者列举了很多具体的数字,加以说明。另外一个例子,Pisa的准备塔。你读的读法中,你对什么目标?哪里在塔?谁设计塔?为什么塔准备准备准备准备?会不会是塔?会不会是塔准备准备准备准备准备准备准备准备使用?一个,瀏覽它的 enhancements, sounds,和었던和那个那个那个。他会拍到agens straight?When I'm going to read this text, I really want to know the answers to the following questions.What ingredients do we need?What are the specific steps?Is there anything special to pay attention to during the process?This article introduces the process of making raisin scones in sequence.这篇文章按先后顺序向我们介绍了蹄子松饼的制作过程。Schools in America and BritainThis article is from New Century English.After reading the title, most of you might focus on the similarities and the differences.What's the difference between American schools and British schools?What do American schools have in common with British schools?This writing method of exposition is called comparison.Now, let's get some practice.Figuring out what the writer introduces is very important for us to have a better understanding of the whole article.Let's have a try.Please get your worksheet ready.Task 1Task 1When you are preparing for a dinner party, you might wonder about the correct placement of the spoons, forks, knives, etc.There are rules about how you should set the table.Today, let's take a look at some basic ones.What is the writer going to introduce to us?Have you got the answer?Let's check.The writer is going to introduce some basic rules about how to set the table.Task 2Do you know what social eating is?It's not a supper club.In fact, it's a Western name for the South Korean online trend, mukbang.Shall we check the answer?I think the writer is going to introduce social eating, the South Korean online trend, mukbang.除了介绍具体事物的特征或公益流程,英语说明文也经常向读者介绍新的流行事物或现象。Well, let's move on to task 3.These are the body paragraphs from an expository text.Please read carefully and finish the exercises.What is the special function of smart glasses?Please give an example.Smart glasses can display information on their lenses.For example, athletes wearing smart glasses can watch a map while they are running.You can also give an example like this.Athletes can also see their heart rate and the step count on the lenses.In the following paragraph, the writer introduces another kind of wearable technology by giving an example.作者运用了举例的方法,对智能太阳眼镜和智能瑜伽训练库进行了说明。Through these examples, we know about the wearable technology much better.Well done.Now let's take a look at task 4.Read these paragraphs carefully and answer the question.How much hotter is the surface of the sun than the hottest lava on earth?Very good.It is about five times hotter than the hottest lava on earth.In these paragraphs, the writer compares the temperature of the sun with that of the lava on earth.And there are many specific numbers related to the temperature.Now let's get some more practice.It's more challenging.Task 5You will have some time to read the whole article and finish the exercises.Try your best.Time is up.Let's check the answers.What does the writer introduce to us?The writer introduces us to the question.We can find the answer in the introduction.Good.The writer introduces how a burger stylist makes a burger look attractive in advertisements.Do you remember what this kind of writing method in an exposition is called?Sequence.The writer introduces how a burger looks more attractive in advertisements.The answers to the three questions can be found in the whole process.How can we get the information we need more efficiently?We can use scanning.According to the article, what's the use of toothpicks?The keywords in the question is toothpicks.Here is the information we need.Burger stylists use them to fix the lettuce on a bun.Of course, you can also answer like this.They are used to fix the lettuce on a bun.When is the cheese slice ready to use?When its edge melts naturally.It's a multiple choice.How did you get the information?Actually, we should focus on the tools which are used when the stylist is styling the burger.Pay attention to the words in the red boxes.Now we can see all the tools mentioned in the choices.Now we can see all the tools mentioned in the choices are used except a knife.So the correct answer is D.Good job.Now let's move on to task 6.Can you figure out what the writer introduces in the article?Yes, Thai boxing.Read the text and finish the exercises.Can you tell me what sport the writer compares Thai boxing with?Right, boxing.The writer uses comparison here.Now let's check the answers.A Thai boxing match begins with?Let's find the answer.A Thai boxing match begins with music.Like boxers, Thai boxers also hit with their?Let's take a look at the differences between boxing and Thai boxing.Now we know both boxers and Thai boxers hit with their hands.Thai boxing began?This multiple choice is about the history of Thai boxing.Let's take a look.Thai boxing began over 500 years ago.If a soldier lost his weapons in a battle, he needed to fight with just his body.The soldiers learned how to use all the parts of their bodies.Thai boxing
